scope: design only: no sim/, no Godot, no reference change; fixes cases, tolerances and mutants for a later implementation behind a default-off switch

property_set.question: gas property set of the integrated network
property_set.alternative: cfast_tn1889 (cp 1.012) requires changing cp in every E writer; separate gate

adopt_vdp.question: does the F2.2 network adopt the first law with V dp behind a new default-off switch

initial_inventory.question: with a fixed R, initial room mass p_ext V/(R T_ref) instead of 1.2 V when the switch is on

tolerances.rationale: receipt and closure classes are those of the M4-P2 plan; ratio and quasi-steady classes are analytic properties checked in the witnesses before any engine run. None may be widened to accept an implementation.

witnesses.what: same heat and parcels: M4-P2 dp equals gamma times the F2.2 dp in any state
witnesses.check: ratio == gamma within first_step_ratio_relative for heat, inflow, outflow and mixed

witnesses.what: leaky heated room: F2.2 starts gamma times too slow and reaches the same quasi-steady pressure
witnesses.check: early ratio within 1 % of gamma; ratio within quasi_steady_relative of 1 after the transient (leak 5e-3 m2, 10 kW, 50 m3, t = 30 s)

witnesses.what: explicit E <-> U adapter and local enthalpy of an (dm, dE) pair
witnesses.check: round trip and heat/inflow/outflow mapping within receipt_identity_relative

witnesses.what: legacy initial mass 1.2 V under a fixed R
witnesses.check: gauge offset above 3000 Pa at 283.15 and 303.15 K; zero within initial_gauge_abs_pa with p_ext V/(R T_ref)

witnesses.what: one engine step as two events (local, then openings)
witnesses.check: same layer split: equal to one event within receipt_identity_relative; different splits: room U exact, layer split differs at first order and is published

witnesses.what: F2.2C collective scaling drains a layer exactly; with heat the M4-P2 rule rejects
witnesses.check: reject:layer_depleted_while_pressure_changes, so the integration must split the step

cases.title: switch off: default engine and network-on with the new switch off are byte-identical to the current commit
checks: flag inventory 85 with the new flag off

cases.title: every network commit replayed by the M4-P2 oracle
checks: building energy closure dU = sum Q_local + H_boundary

cases.title: sealed room, prescribed heat, first step from the same state
sealed two-layer room, heat in the upper layer only
checks: lower layer isentropic: T_l (p0/p)^k constant within receipt_identity_relative per step

cases.title: leaky heated room after the transient
layer fully drained by collective scaling while pressure changes
checks: step split at the depletion fraction or a named network failure; never a silent residue

cases.title: initial state at 283.15, 293.15 and 303.15 K with the switch on
timestep: sealed heater and leaky room at 1/60, 1/12 and 1/3 s
checks: heater-only dt-independent within receipt_identity_relative x steps
leaky room error published, no new threshold

cases.title: cfast_single_room_closed with the network and the new switch on
checks: pressure trace reported against CFAST and against the switch off; no tolerance change
